newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Elec unit closes $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Elec unit closes $100 mln FRN.

text.p: Gallatin International Ltd's US$100 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger Sanwa International Finance said. The deal is guaranteed by Pacific Electric Wire and Cable Co Ltd.
The issue has a final maturity of five years with a call option in year three.
The issue was priced at par to float at 70 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, all-in return for top-tier managers is 74 basis points.

Arranger and bookrunner Sanwa International Finance committed US$21 million. BNP Taipei committed US$10 million. Other arrangers with US$10 million each are Daiwa Securities HK and Sumitomo Trust Finance Hong Kong and Hamburgische Landesbank Girozentrale Hong Kong Branch.

Co-arranger Chang Hwa Commercial Bank committed US$7 million. Co-lead managers with US$5 million each are the Chinese Bank Offshore Banking Branch, ING Barings, LTCB Asia, and Taishin International Bank.

Managers with US$3 million each are China Trust Commercial Bank, Taipei Business Bank Macau branch. Managers with US$2 million each are Development Bank of Singapore, Banca Nazionale Del Lavoro SpA Hong Kong Branch, and Bank Hapoalim.
